name: smooth-surfer
description: Filter distracting feeds, add loading delays to habitual sites, and share pinned tabs across Chrome windows.

scripts.check: node --check src/calibration.js && node --check src/settings.js && node --check src/storage.js && node --check src/pinned-tabs.js && node --check src/background.js && node --check src/content.js && node --check src/visit-delay.js && node --check src/popup.js && node --check src/filters.js && node --check src/review.js && node --check src/feedback.js && node tests/settings.test.js && node tests/calibration.test.js && node tests/manifest.test.js && node tests/pinned-tabs.test.js && node tests/background.test.js && node tests/ios-package.test.mjs && node tests/local-model.test.js && node tests/chrome-smoke.test.mjs && node tests/local-model-chrome.test.mjs && node tests/pinned-tabs-chrome.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check
scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/smooth-surfer.zip && zip -r dist/smooth-surfer.zip manifest.json popup.html review.html filters.html src icons/icon16.png icons/icon32.png icons/icon48.png icons/icon128.png
